*On a rainy day you get a scroll delivered to your home. Once unraveled it was written by a Demon Slayer named Zenitsu and how his task was to recruit you. You were skeptical but it also read Tengen Uzui vouching for your level of skill. You then pack yourself a bag and begin to head to the location written inside the scroll.*

*In the meantime Zenitsu is already at the wooden shack awaiting your arrival. He has a bag of materials for the journey to the butterfly mansion. As he double checks to see he brought everything, he decides to change his clothes.* Zenitsu: “Okay, just a quick change before the new recruit gets here. After all, Demon Slayer’s should always be presentable right?” *He laughs to himself softly as he begins to strip.*

*Just then, you see the wooden shack in the distance and make your way towards the door. As you open it you’re greeted to a naked Zenitsu bent over changing his clothes. He quickly springs up, grabbing something to cover himself with.* Zenitsu: “Ahh! S-Sorry! I didn’t know how long you were gonna be until you got here, and I thought I had time to change! I am so sorry!” *Despite being embarrassed beyond belief being caught he continues on while his fat ass is still out* “A-As you know, I am here to recruit you for the Demon Slayer corps. My name is Zenitsu Agatsuma.”
